bullets.title: Protection That Lasts
bullets.text: The included battery provides up to 2 years of power for round-the-clock security.

bullets.title: Extensive Coverage
bullets.text: Detects motion within a 100° radius and up to 30 feet away — more than enough to secure an entire room of your home.

bullets.title: Adjustable Sensitivity
bullets.text: Tailor the sensitivity of the motion sensor so that it only alerts when humans are in range — rather than your playful pet dog or cat.

bullets.title: App Alerts
bullets.text: Notifies you as soon as motion is detected by sending a message to your phone via the eufy Security app, no matter where you are.

bullets.title: Link it Up
bullets.text: Connects to eufy Security HomeBase (Sold separately) as well as other eufy Security products. Simply pair it via the eufy Security app then press the button on the sensor to add it to your system.

bullets.title: 2-Year Battery Life
bullets.text: One battery provides monitoring for 730 days.

bullets.title: For Doors and Windows
bullets.text: Small and compact design fits onto any door or window frame.

bullets.title: 100-Decibel Siren
bullets.text: If a forced entry is detected, a siren, as loud as a jackhammer, will be triggered on HomeBase and you'll be notified instantly on your smartphone.

bullets.title: Easy Installation
bullets.text: Just peel off the mounting tape and stick the sensor onto the door or window you want to monitor.

bullets.title: Ideal Lighting
bullets.text: Provides the right amount of glare-free lighting to guide you in the dark.

bullets.title: Automatic Illumination
bullets.text: When light sensor perceives darkness, motion sensor activates lighting when movement is detected.

bullets.title: Energy Efficient
bullets.text: Three AAA batteries (not included) provide soft illumination for up to a year.

bullets.title: Nighttime Navigation
bullets.text: Eliminates need to turn on blinding lights in the middle of the night.

bullets.title: What you Get
bullets.text: 3x Lumi Stick-On Night Lights, 6x Screw, 6x Wall Plugs, User Manual.

bullets.title: Compatible with All eufyCams
bullets.text: Provide continuous charging for your eufyCam, eufyCam E, eufyCam 2, eufyCam 2 Pro, eufyCam 2C, or eufyCam 2C Pro.

bullets.title: Solar-Powered Continuous Charging
bullets.text: With the 2.6W high-efficiency solar panel and a few hours of direct sunlight per day, your camera will stay charged round the clock.

bullets.title: Easy to Install
bullets.text: The 13ft (4m) cable allows for flexibility to place the solar panel where it can get maximum sunlight exposure. The 360-degree mounting bracket and wall anchors make installation easy and flexible.

bullets.title: Certified Safe for eufyCam
bullets.text: Only certified eufy security solar panels can sync with eufyCam for a correct power management. Non-certified solar panels may damage the eufyCam battery.

bullets.title: IP65 Weatherproof
bullets.text: Built to withstand extreme weather conditions.

bullets.title: Next-Gen Speed
bullets.text: Equipped with a USB-C Power Delivery port, and loaded with 20W of output power to give the latest iPhones a full-speed charge.

bullets.title: Two-in-One
bullets.text: With 1 USB-C Power Delivery port, and 1 USB port with Anker's PowerIQ, you're ready to charge two of your devices simultaneously.

bullets.title: Size Matters
bullets.text: All this power comes installed in a pocket-friendly compact body, to go wherever the journey takes you.

bullets.title: Universal Compatibility
bullets.text: Charge virtually all your mobile devices at maximum speed with USB-C and standard USB input.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: PowerPort PD+ 2, welcome guide, 12-month stress-free warranty, and friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Strengthened Construction
bullets.text: One of the first ever charging cables built with bulletproof aramid fiber, PowerLine is much stronger than ordinary cables.

bullets.title: Lasts 10X Longer
bullets.text: Reinforced stress points with a 10,000+ bend lifespan make PowerLine many times more durable than anything else on the market.

bullets.title: Faster Charging
bullets.text: Thick gauge wiring and reduced cable resistance enable PowerLine to provide the fastest possible charge via any USB charger, plus high-speed data transfer.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker PowerLine Micro USB, our worry-free 12-month warranty, and friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Ultimate Durability
bullets.text: Aramid fiber makes it thoroughly resistant to fraying and wear-related damage.

bullets.title: Fast Charging
bullets.text: Wide-diameter wires and reduced cord resistance maximize charge speed. Capable of charging an iPhone 8 or later from 0 — 50% in just 30 minutes

bullets.title: Strength in Numbers
bullets.text: Redesigned connectors allow the cable to survive a 15000+ bending test, beating all competitors in the market

bullets.title: Apple Certified
bullets.text: MFi certification and strict quality testing ensure your Apple devices are charged safely, at their fastest possible speed.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker PowerLine Select+ USB-A to Lightning cable, welcome guide, our worry-free 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Your Finger is the Key
bullets.text: Smart Lock recognizes your fingerprint in just 0.3 seconds and unlocks your door in 1 second — it's faster than fumbling for your keys.

bullets.title: Control From Anywhere
bullets.text: With its all-new Wi-Fi connectivity, you can control Smart Lock from absolutely anywhere via the eufy Security app.

bullets.title: Always Has Your Back
bullets.text: Even when you're in a hurry, Smart Lock is ready to protect your home. A built-in sensor detects when your door is closed and locks it automatically behind you, every time.

bullets.title: Multiple Ways to Unlock
bullets.text: Open Smart Lock using your fingerprint, with your phone via the eufy Security app, or by using the keypad or key.

bullets.title: Built to Last
bullets.text: With a sturdy zinc alloy and stainless steel frame, Smart Lock is tested to handle the comings and goings of a busy household for over 30 years. The IP65 rating ensures that come rain or shine, your front door is protected.

bullets.title: Forever Power, Solar Style
bullets.text: Just 2 hours of direct sunlight each day is enough to continuously power SoloCam S40, so you never have to worry about changing the battery. And when the sun sets, the built-in battery keeps the juice flowing.

bullets.title: Light Up the Night
bullets.text: The ultra-bright 600 Lumens spotlight switches on as soon as motion is detected, shining a light on any unwanted guests, while the color night vision picks out details in the darkness up to 8 meters away.

bullets.title: The Key is in the Detail
bullets.text: Capture every event that occurs around your home in ultra-clear 2K resolution.

bullets.title: No Hidden Costs
bullets.text: SoloCam is a one-time purchase. There are no monthly fees or hidden costs. Everything is done on-device for complete security and transparency.

bullets.title: Relevant Recordings
bullets.text: The built-in AI ensures SoloCam S40 only records when a person is present, rather than an animal.
